facts.business: ABB India Limited operates in electrification, automation, and digitalization across industries, providing products, systems, and services for power grids, industrial automation, and related sectors.
key_risks: Global supply chain and geopolitical shifts
Estimation of total contract costs and remaining costs to completion for fixed price contracts
Operational delays, contract terms, changes in estimations, technical, legal, external environment risks
facts.related_party_note: Parent Company: ABB Limited, Zurich, Switzerland (Ultimate Holding Company); ABB Asea Brown Boveri Limited, Zurich, Switzerland (Holding Company). Fellow subsidiaries include ABB Global Industries and Services Private Limited, Bengaluru; ABB Business Services Private Limited, Bengaluru. Subsidiary: ABB Robotics India Private Limited. Entities under common control and with common directors also listed.
